title: Conflict Protocol
concept: The full path through a conflict: check if you’re calm enough to talk, warm up, make sure it’s safe, say what happened, ask for one thing, and follow through.
whenToUse: When a fight has started, or it’s one you keep having, and you can both still be warm with each other (or once a Pause + Return has brought you back to calm).
steps: Check if you’re calm — flooded? Take a Pause + Return first.
Warm up — say one warm, true thing.
Make it safe — remind each other you’re not breaking up.
Say what happened — “When X happened, I felt Y; here’s the impact.”
Ask for one thing — be specific.
Listen in the right order — impact first, what would help second, their side last.
Get proof if you need it — turn it into a Proof item (Proof Protocol card).
Line up next steps — who does what, and when you’ll check back.

phrases.text: I’m on your team, even though I’m frustrated.
Can we soften the room first?
I think we’re in Reach–Recoil. Twenty-minute pause?

working: A opens: “I’m on your team, even though I’m frustrated.” B hears how the missed pickup landed before explaining. They agree one ask and put a check-in in the diary, and the evening survives.
notWorking: The opener is “Why didn’t you text about the pickup?”, with no warm-up. One of you cross-examines, the other goes quiet, and by nine you’re both arguing about the tone, not the pickup. Fix: keep a few warm-up phrases ready and check they’ve landed before moving on.
activity: Practise once on a minor gripe, with a timer. Whoever’s listening makes sure the order is followed.
